metadata.title: Remote Sensing Scientist Academy
metadata.description: Practical, rigorous online training for the next generation of remote sensing scientists.

hero.title: Read the planet.
hero.intro: An intensive online academy for the next generation of remote sensing scientists—built around real satellite data, rigorous analysis, and problems that matter.

pathsSection.summary: Start with one focused path or combine all three into the complete Remote Sensing Scientist program.

items.label: FOUNDATIONS
items.title: Earth Observation Essentials
items.description: Build fluency in spectral signatures, sensor systems, resolutions, and the physics behind every pixel.

items.label: ANALYSIS
items.title: Geospatial Data Science
items.description: Move from raw scenes to defensible insight with Python, cloud workflows, and reproducible spatial analysis.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.title: Climate Intelligence
items.description: Detect change, quantify risk, and communicate environmental signals across time and scale.

fieldLab.title: Measure recovery after the fire.
fieldLab.lead: In this guided investigation, you’ll build a multi-year recovery model from Sentinel-2 imagery and explain where—and why—the landscape is struggling to return.

steps.title: Assemble the time series
steps.description: Filter, mask, and harmonize six years of surface reflectance.

steps.title: Model the signal
steps.description: Quantify burn severity and vegetation recovery trajectories.

steps.title: Defend the finding
steps.description: Validate uncertainty and deliver a concise scientific briefing.

modules.title: See beyond RGB
modules.description: Sensor physics, spectral response, atmospheric effects, and the anatomy of an Earth observation product.

modules.title: Build the processing chain
modules.description: Search catalogs, prepare data cubes, engineer indices, classify land cover, and validate your results.

modules.title: Turn signals into decisions
modules.description: Design a complete monitoring product and present findings with the uncertainty decision-makers need.

outcomes.title: Graduate with more than a certificate.
outcomes.description: Leave with a reviewed portfolio, a reproducible analysis workflow, and the confidence to explain technical results to real decision-makers.

application.title: The planet is already talking.
application.description: Learn how to listen—then turn the signal into action.

footer.description: Serious training for people who want to understand a changing planet.
